description: One line of the paper payslip in a Payslip Structure

fields.description: Line number on the paper payslip: 1, 1.2, 7.4. Sets the order of the lines and matches the Excel column (the header starts with it)
fields.label: No.

fields.description: English text of the paper payslip, e.g. Basic Salary
fields.label: English Label

fields.description: Vietnamese text: shown on the Mini App and next to the English text on the printout, e.g. Lương cơ bản
fields.label: Vietnamese Label

fields.description: Printed in brackets after the label, as typed, e.g. c=a+b or 8%. Display only: ERP never checks or computes it. Empty = nothing printed
fields.label: Formula

fields.description: VND = an amount. Day / Hour = the line only has a number of days / hours (e.g. standard working days)
fields.label: Unit

fields.description: An amount line that also has a number in the Unit/ĐVT column (e.g. 1.2 = 24 days + the amount). The Excel template then has a "<No.> Days" / "<No.> Hours" column
fields.label: Unit/ĐVT Column

fields.description: No. of the group line this one sits under (indented), e.g. 2 for 2.1. Empty = a main line
fields.label: Under Line

fields.description: Subtotal / Section Total are printed in bold and shown even when 0
fields.label: Row Type

fields.description: Block of the older Mini App screen (payslip `sections`). Attendance = days / overtime hours
fields.label: Block
